Some feedback on the highlight, I think this is a bit too contrasted in terms of information hierarchy, and makes the highlighted parts look like buttons. What do you think of going with something like this instead? Used values: ```css background-color: rgba(var(--ais-primary-color-rgb), 0.2); /* 0.1 in light mode */ color: rgba(var(--ais-primary-color-rgb), var(--ais-primary-color-alpha)); border-radius: 2px; /* we don't have to use the same radius as for buttons, it makes sense for customers to want to change them independently */ ``` Thoughts?
